channel.title: Orchard
channel.description: Apple news, rumors and iPhone Duo apps, each with its source. An independent site, not affiliated with Apple.

item.title: Researchers say an iOS sandbox flaw is still unpatched
item.description: Two security researchers published proof-of-concept code for a flaw they call worse_query, which they say lets a malicious app read other apps' local files. Binance warned that this could expose crypto seed phrases, private keys and logins, and named iOS 26.7.1, 27.0.1 and 27.2 as affected. The…

item.title: CNET battery test: iPhone 18 Pro Max beats 31 other phones
item.description: CNET ran 32 phones through three hours of video streaming at full brightness plus 45 minutes of mixed use. iPhone 18 Pro Max came first overall and kept 99% in the mixed test. iPhone 18 Pro had the best streaming result with 94% left. iPhone Duo also kept 99% in mixed use and tied for fourth…

item.title: watchOS 27.3 brings Live Rewind and Siri Recap next month
item.description: watchOS 27.3, due for everyone next month, adds Siri AI actions in built-in apps such as Calendar, Mail, Maps, Messages and Notes, plus four new Siri languages: traditional Chinese, Norwegian, Turkish and Vietnamese. Live Rewind, shown in September, lets you double-press the Digital Crown on…

item.title: iOS 27.3 beta adds a Global Privacy Control switch to Safari
item.description: A new 'Use Global Privacy Control' setting under Settings > Apps > Safari > Advanced lets Safari ask websites not to sell or share your data. Sites have to support the signal for it to do anything, and few do yet, so it won't cut down cookie pop-ups much for now.

item.title: Bigger iCloud+ plans add AI search for home camera clips
item.description: In iOS 27, iCloud+ subscribers on the 2TB, 6TB and 12TB plans get Apple Intelligence features for HomeKit Secure Video cameras: written descriptions of recorded clips and plain-language search of recordings. 2TB covers one camera, 6TB two and 12TB five. You need a home hub such as HomePod or Apple…

item.title: Apple Invites adds polls and an animated emoji effect
item.description: An update to the Apple Invites app lets hosts add polls so guests can vote on things like the theme or food, and adds an emoji effect that moves across the invitation. Creating events still needs iCloud+; anyone with the link can reply for free.

item.title: Google's Gemini app arrives on CarPlay
item.description: Google is rolling out a standalone Gemini app for CarPlay worldwide, in several languages. You need the latest Gemini app on your iPhone, and chats carry over between phone and car. ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, Grok and Perplexity were already on CarPlay.

item.title: Apple met Thai officials over spyware alerts sent to politicians
item.description: Bloomberg reports that Thailand's government met Apple about the threat notifications some Thai politicians received in Apple's late-October wave. A Thai minister said an alert doesn't necessarily mean a device was hacked, and officials say they have no evidence so far that Pegasus was involved.

item.title: A supplier hints it is working on Apple's AI glasses
item.description: Chinese equipment maker Quick Intelligent Equipment told investors it has worked on 'Apple's AI glasses and new smart earphones projects', according to Securities Times. Apple hasn't announced smart glasses; earlier reports point to a late-2027 launch.

item.title: Apple's holiday gift guide is live, with returns open until 8 January
item.description: Apple has switched its US homepage and others to a holiday gift guide that leads with iPhone Duo ($1,999) alongside iPhone 18 Pro, Apple Watch Series 12, Apple Watch Ultra 4, HomeView, iPad mini and both MacBook Pro models. A holiday accessories page adds cases, bags and chargers from makers such…

item.title: Apple is shutting down its Support Community forums on 20 November
item.description: Apple's user-to-user help forums, which date back to 1998, stopped taking new posts on 10 November and will close for good on 20 November. Apple told MacRumors the call followed a review of its strategy and customer needs. It has not named a replacement; its notice points people to the Apple…

item.title: Finding the new Siri Remote precisely needs an iPhone 17 or newer
item.description: The fourth-generation Siri Remote can be tracked down with step-by-step Precision Finding in the Find My app, but 9to5Mac reports this only works with an iPhone 17 or later, including iPhone Air, iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro; the iPhone 17e is left out. Older iPhones can still make the remote's…

item.title: iCloud Mail, Calendar, Photos and more go down
item.description: Apple's System Status page confirmed an outage from about 5:49 p.m. ET (2:49 p.m. PT) on 10 November. Affected: iCloud Mail, Calendar and Contacts, iWork for iCloud, Photos, Game Center and iCloud account sign-in. Find My was listed as possibly slow or unavailable. Some users could not send or…

item.title: New AirPods firmware 9B47 rolls out
item.description: Apple released firmware 9B47 for AirPods with the H2 chip, replacing 9A348/9A350. It is expected for AirPods Pro 2 and 3, AirPods 4 and 5 and AirPods Max 2, and was in beta for several weeks. Apple has not yet published what changed. It installs on its own while the AirPods are charging and near a…

item.title: iFixit teardown: touchscreen MacBook Pro scores 5 out of 10
item.description: The glowing rear logo uses four LEDs behind a mirror-like layer, so fixing it means removing the display, and iFixit's OLED broke while trying. Memory, SSD, HDMI port and SD slot are soldered. Swapping logic boards between two units worked after Repair Assistant, touchscreen and Touch ID included.…

item.title: Three workers die at an iPhone parts plant in India
item.description: Three contract workers died after inhaling gas while inspecting a tank at the wastewater plant of Tata Electronics' Hosur factory in Tamil Nadu. Reuters says an Apple team is visiting to help the investigation. Tata and state authorities are also investigating. Production was not affected because…

item.title: Apple TV app adds sign language interpretation
item.description: A new Sign Language option in the Apple TV app shows a sign language interpreter alongside supported titles. It starts on 13 November with Being Heumann and F1, with Way of the Warrior Kid and Greyhound later this year. ASL and BSL are supported. You need iOS, iPadOS, macOS, tvOS or visionOS 27.2…

item.title: Swift Student Challenge 2027 opens to every Apple platform
item.description: Students can submit an app between 8 and 28 February 2027. For the first time, entries can target any Apple platform, including watchOS, tvOS and visionOS. Each app must be experienced in under three minutes. Winners get a year of Apple Developer Program membership, and Distinguished Winners are…

item.title: Football Manager 27 Touch leads Apple Arcade's holiday games
item.description: Football Manager 27 Touch is out now on Apple Arcade. Plants vs. Zombies: Replanted, Prince of Persia: The Lost Crown+, solitaire(ish) and LEGO DUPLO Playtime arrive on 3 December.

item.title: Claris app 'Harbor' could run AI models locally on Macs
item.description: A leak says Apple's Claris brand is privately testing Harbor. The app would turn a Mac into a private AI server that runs open-weight models on Apple silicon. It could also pool memory across several Macs connected over Thunderbolt 5. Apple hasn't announced it, and there is no release date.

item.title: Apple Maps may add parking time to arrival estimates
item.description: Code in the iOS 27.3 beta points to Maps measuring how long parking and the final walk take. That could make arrival times more accurate. For now the flag works only on internal builds, and no Maps feature uses the data.

item.title: Apple plans five Developer Academies and a Developer Center in Türkiye
item.description: Apple announced a multiyear investment in Türkiye as Tim Cook visited the country. It includes five new Apple Developer Academies, one Developer Center and one Manufacturing Academy.

item.title: Apple Intelligence is registered in China for iPad and Mac
item.description: Shanghai's cyberspace regulator says the service is now registered for tablets and laptops, following iPhone approval in July. Apple has said China launch is planned for December with iOS 27.3, but has not confirmed iPad and Mac timing.

item.title: Meta's Muse AI agent now has an Apple Watch app
item.description: The Muse iPhone app update adds a watch app where you can text, dictate or call the agent, plus a complication for quick access.

item.title: Siri may become more of an agent in iOS 28
item.description: Apple is said to be working on a Siri that pursues goals and handles multi-step tasks on its own, possibly as soon as next year. The report also says iOS 28 engineers get a six-week coding phase and two-week integration phase. Based on unnamed sources; nothing is confirmed.

item.title: iOS 27.2.1 and matching updates for Mac, Watch and Vision Pro are out
item.description: Apple released iOS and iPadOS 27.2.1 with bug fixes and security updates, alongside macOS Golden Gate 27.2.1, watchOS 27.2.1 and visionOS 27.2.1. Security-focused updates also went out for older systems: iOS and iPadOS 26.7.3 and 18.7.12, watchOS 26.6.1, and macOS 26.7.3 and 15.8.3 (the last two…

item.title: Apple starts selling $49.99 'intelligence usage packs'
item.description: Apple's first paid AI add-on gives extra use of select AI features once you hit your monthly limit. It is a one-time purchase, not a subscription, and for now it is offered only in Logic Pro. Packs don't work with Family Sharing, and unused usage expires 12 months after purchase. 9to5Mac says…

item.title: Webex shows how its app uses both iPhone Duo screens
item.description: Cisco says Webex was built natively for iPhone Duo. Opening the phone shows more meeting participants while shared content stays visible, and you can use a whiteboard or run Webex beside another app in Split View. The app is already on the App Store.

item.title: HomeView code hints at chatbot apps and a spoofing lockout
item.description: Code in the iOS 27.3 beta contains a "Conversational Apps" category for HomeView, plus groundwork such as two-way audio routing and interruption handling, which the finder says is not fully wired up. Which apps could use it, or when, is unknown. Separately, HomeView software 27.2 asks for iPhone…

item.title: iPhone Duo launch-day buyers: the return window closes soon
item.description: Apple's return period runs from delivery, not order date. In the US, a Duo delivered on launch day (23 October) can be returned until 6 November; in Canada the deadline is 7 November. In the UK and EU, online buyers have 14 days to tell Apple, then 14 more to send it back. This covers purchases…

item.title: CNET's iPhone Duo fold test passes 260,000 folds
item.description: CNET built a "Fold-a-Phone" machine that has been opening and closing a Duo around the clock for over a week, streamed on YouTube on weekdays from 1 to 5 p.m. ET. It has passed 260,000 folds with no failures reported, and the hinge and crease look to be holding up well. Testing continues daily…

item.title: Safari Technology Preview 256 is out
item.description: Apple's test browser gets another round of bug fixes and performance work, covering areas such as CSS, JavaScript, media, networking, rendering, security, WebGL and WebRTC. It installs through Software Update and runs alongside regular Safari.

item.title: iOS 27.3 will scan public iCloud links for harmful content
item.description: Starting with the 27.3 releases, photos and files shared with 'Anyone with the link' will be checked for things like malware and child abuse material, and Apple can remove flagged items or act on the account. Shares sent to chosen people or as copies aren't checked. Publicly linked content is no…

item.title: Apps can now show offers when you try to cancel a subscription
item.description: Developers can set up retention messages with text, images or special offers in App Store Connect, for subscribers who start cancelling an auto-renewable subscription. A separate Retention Messaging API can pick the message per subscriber, but access is by request only.

item.title: Xcode 27.3 beta adds Copilot, Siri AI testing and touchscreen Mac APIs
item.description: The first Xcode 27.3 beta reached developers on 3 November. MacRumors reports three additions: GitHub Copilot in the built-in coding assistant, a way to test Siri AI integration in apps, and new APIs for the upcoming touchscreen MacBook Pro. MacRumors lists no system requirements.

item.title: Google Maps now fills both iPhone Duo screens
item.description: Version 26.44.4 removes the black strip that the previous version left beside the status bar. The map now spreads across the inner screen, with search at the upper left, tabs in a left panel and controls on the right. Google’s release notes do not mention Duo.

item.title: macOS 27.3 beta puts Live Activities in the menu bar
item.description: On Apple silicon Macs without a Dynamic Island, Live Activities now appear in the menu bar. Apple Music, Clock, Voice Memos and screen recording are supported, and third-party apps can add support. The update is expected in December.

item.title: iPhone 18e said to be mostly a chip upgrade
item.description: Leaker Fixed Focus Digital says the chip is the only upgrade he can confirm. Earlier, Digital Chat Station claimed an A20 chip, a 6.12-inch 60Hz OLED and one 48-megapixel camera. Spring 2027 launch expected. Neither leaker is confirmed by Apple. On 9 November Fixed Focus Digital posted a diagram…

item.title: Non-touch high-end MacBook Pros may be phased out
item.description: Mark Gurman (Bloomberg) questions whether Apple will keep updating the non-touch M5 Pro and M5 Max models, saying the two lines are likely to merge. He gave no date. M7 Pro and M7 Max touchscreen models are reportedly planned for 2027.

item.title: Safari gets vertical tabs and an adaptive dark mode in the 27.3 betas
item.description: Tabs can now run down the left side of the screen, which suits the iPhone Duo's larger display. A new adaptive Dark Mode darkens bright sites, and Siri can sort and close tabs. Siri understanding full page content comes later. Public release is expected in December.
